method.enumeration: Every SQL statement literal executed through storage::Database (db.exec / db.prepare / run_in_txn / scalar helpers) across the pre-committed source list, counted per source-literal statement site (a multi-statement exec string counts each contained statement; statement texts reused at multiple call sites count each literal site). schema_sql.hpp kCanonicalSchemaSql is executed by migrate.cpp apply_migrations and is counted once at its own file (referenced, not double-counted under migrate.cpp). Transaction-control statements (BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK/SAVEPOINT/RELEASE) are counted because they are executed via db.exec. Statements inside trigger BODIES are part of their CREATE TRIGGER statement and not counted separately.
method.classification_rule: portable = executable by PostgreSQL unchanged (parameter style handled globally, see global_notes). translatable = mechanical rewrite with a per-construct rewrite_rule (INSERT OR IGNORE, datetime(), last_insert_rowid(), json/sqlite functions, PRAGMA, sqlite_master, AUTOINCREMENT, COLLATE BINARY, temp. schema, typeof, BLOB DDL type). structural = requires abstraction; per P0-3 every structural item MUST cite one of the three D0.5 resolution points (fts_search / backup_to+backend_file_path / busy-mapping-in-D1); anything that cannot is UNRESOLVED.

global_notes: Parameter style: all statements bind positionally ('?' / '?1'); the IStatement bind-by-index contract is the abstraction point (PG backend rewrites markers to $N at prepare). Recorded once globally, not per statement, per P0-3 taxonomy.
Blob transport: embedding blobs are packed/unpacked in the app layer (search::pack_f32/unpack_f32); only the column type (BLOB -> bytea) is a DDL concern.

Text timestamps: created_at/updated_at/lock_until are TEXT UTC strings written by util::utc_now() from the app layer; PG D2 uses timestamptz and the comparison/arithmetic rewrites above must keep byte-identical ordering semantics (P2-3).
changes()/last_insert_rowid(): changes() maps to PG row-count (backend interface already returns int); last_insert_rowid() occurrences are enumerated above as RETURNING rewrites.
sqlite_sequence / AUTOINCREMENT: no production statement reads sqlite_sequence (comments only); identity mapping is DDL-level (D2).
